T: A prince walks into a burger joint in Queens.
D: An African prince goes to Queens to find a bride and takes a job at a fast food joint.
P: Serve the burgers when the Big Mick comes out at McDowell's.
S: Thin chips soaked in cold water, blanched at 140C, fried at 190C until golden, salt straight away.
Thick-cut onion rings in crisp beer batter, stacked high with house sauce, argued over at the barbershop next door.

Thick onion rings dusted in flour, dipped in a cold lager batter and fried at 180C until crisp, stacked high with house sauce. Slice 3 large brown onions 1.5cm thick and separate the rings. Toss in 50g plain flour. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt with 250ml cold lager until smooth. Dip the rings and fry in batches for 3 minutes until golden, then drain and salt. Stir 125g mayonnaise with 2 tbsp sweet pickle relish, 1 tsp American mustard, 1/2 tsp paprika and 1 tsp white vinegar for the house sauce.
M: Beef burger on a bun with no seeds.
Two thin smashed patties, American cheese, shredded iceberg, diced onion, pickles and special sauce (mayo, sweet relish, mustard, paprika, vinegar) on a plain seedless three-piece bun.
Fried chicken glistening like the Soul Glo hair ad.
Chicken brined in buttermilk and hot sauce, double-dredged, fried at 165C, then brushed with hot honey butter so it shines.
W: Crisp baked pastry pocket of hot cinnamon apple and brown sugar, McDowell's own version.

Shortcrust pockets filled with hot cinnamon apple and brown sugar, crimped and baked at 200C until crisp. Cook 3 diced Granny Smith apples with 30g butter, 40g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tbsp lemon juice for 8 minutes, then thicken with 1 tsp cornflour in a splash of water and cool. Cut 2 sheets shortcrust pastry into 4 rectangles each, fill one half, fold, crimp with a fork and cut two slits. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with raw sugar and bake at 200C for 22 minutes.
Thin rosewater cookies with crushed dried flowers, baked crisp, scattered like the royal petals.
Rosewater sugar cookie dough rolled thin, crushed dried rose petals pressed on top, baked at 170C for 9 minutes until just crisp.
K: Three scoops of ice cream blended with milk until dense, from a counter that isn't McDonald's.
Blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk until thick.

flavour.sign: Queens, New York. Burgers, fries, thick shakes.

note.text: Fries are hot, shakes are thick, and the new guy cleans the floor like it's a royal palace. Welcome to McDowell's.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the cut potatoes in cold water up to 1 day ahead in the fridge, or do the first fry up to 2 hours ahead; finish fresh at 190C

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin chips and soak in cold water.
Dry well.
Heat the oil to 140C and fry the potatoes, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until golden and crisp.
Salt straight away and serve hot.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the house sauce up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; batter and fry at the last minute

steps.text: Heat the oil to 180C in a deep pot.
Slice the onions 1.5cm thick, separate the rings and toss them in 50g of the flour.
Whisk the rest of the flour, the baking powder and salt with the cold lager until smooth.
Dip the rings in the batter and fry in batches until golden and crisp, 3 minutes a batch. Drain and salt.
Stir the mayonnaise, relish, mustard, paprika and vinegar into the house sauce.
Stack the rings high and serve with the sauce.

af.make_ahead: Make the house sauce up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; batter and fry at the last minute

steps.text: Heat the oil to 180C in a deep pot.
Slice the onions 1.5cm thick, separate the rings and toss them in 50g of the flour.
Whisk the rest of the flour, the baking powder and salt with the cold soda water until smooth.
Dip the rings in the batter and fry in batches until golden and crisp, 3 minutes a batch. Drain and salt.
Stir the mayonnaise, relish, mustard, paprika and vinegar into the house sauce.
Stack the rings high and serve with the sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the sauce up to 3 days ahead in the fridge and shape the patties up to 1 day ahead; cook and build fresh

steps.text: Mix the mayonnaise, relish, mustard, paprika and vinegar for the sauce.
Shape the mince into 8 thin patties.
Smash the patties in a hot pan and add the cheese.
Toast the buns.
Build each with sauce, lettuce, onion, pickles and patties in the three-piece bun.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sauce up to 3 days ahead in the fridge and shape the plant-based patties up to 4 hours ahead; cook and build fresh

steps.text: Mix the mayonnaise, relish, mustard, paprika and vinegar for the sauce.
Shape the plant-based mince into 8 thin patties.
Smash the patties in a hot pan with the oil and add the cheese.
Toast the buns.
Build each with sauce, lettuce, onion, pickles and patties in the three-piece bun.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead; bake on the night so the pastry stays crisp

steps.text: Cook the apples with the butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice until just soft.
Stir in the cornflour mixed with a splash of water and cook until thick.
Cool the filling.
Heat the oven to 200C. Cut each pastry sheet into 4 rectangles, fill one half, fold over, crimp with a fork and cut two slits on top.
Brush with the egg, sprinkle with raw sugar and bake until crisp and golden.
Beat the butter with the sugar and rose water, then mix in the flour.
Roll thin and cut into rounds.
Press crushed rose petals on top.
Bake at 170C until just crisp at the edges.
Cool on the tray.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the glasses in the freezer up to 1 day ahead; blend to order, one shake at a time

steps.text: Chill four tall glasses.
Blend three scoops of ice cream with some of the milk until thick and smooth, one shake at a time.
Pour into a chilled glass and serve with a wide straw.

veg: Double beef, cheese, pickles, shredded lettuce, onion and house sauce on a three-piece bun. No sesame seeds.
Double veggie patty, cheese, pickles, lettuce, onion and house sauce on a three-piece bun. No sesame seeds.
